---
title: "R Analysis: GDP per Capita: Taiwan vs. Canada"
author: "Ethan Chen"
date: "2026-09-23"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

df <- read_csv("gapminder.csv")
```

Data: Gapminder (https://www.gapminder.org/data/), 
via the Software Carpentry r-novice-gapminder lesson 
(https://github.com/swcarpentry/r-novice-gapminder), CC BY 4.0.

```{r}
#| label: prep-data
gdp_compare <- df |>
  filter(country %in% c("Taiwan", "Canada")) |>
  select(country, year, gdpPercap, pop) |>
  mutate(gdp_total_billions = (gdpPercap * pop) / 1e9)

head(gdp_compare)
```



```{r}
#| label: fig-gdp-percap
#| fig-cap: "GDP per capita over time, Taiwan vs. Canada (Gapminder data)."
ggplot(gdp_compare, aes(x = year, y = gdpPercap, color = country)) + geom_line()
labs(x = "Year", y = "GDP per capita")
```
